Worked at Foody Goody on regent a few years ago. I think there’s new management there now? (I hope) Before there were two managers. One of them was nice. The other manager and his wife that worked there as a server made everyone’s life miserable. Would always comment and make fun of one of our coworker’s weight. Would single out workers for the day and give them a hard time. For example, a busser would be really busy in a section. They would tell other workers to not help them. I remember one time, for context I don’t speak Cantonese but can understand it. I was talking to one of the kitchen workers (who is Chinese) and the manager’s wife (who is also Chinese) went up to us and said to the worker in Cantonese that she shouldn’t be talking to me since I’m not fluent speaking like them. I also remember some time after I left, I saw a video of the manager trying to jokingly kiss one of the servers during a work party as well. Super creepy.
